testimonials.description: Hear from teammates, managers, and clients who have collaborated with me on software engineering and digital products.

sura_cedeno.name: Sura Cedeño
sura_cedeno.quote: I would highly recommend Brandon. He is a professional with excellent attention to detail, capable of perfecting every aspect of his work. His ability to spot even the smallest errors and correct them demonstrates his commitment to quality and excellence. Furthermore, he is a true team player, effectively collaborating with colleagues and bringing valuable ideas to projects. His teamwork skills and dedication to refinement make him a valuable asset to any frontend development team.

carlos_cespedes.name: Carlos Céspedes
carlos_cespedes.quote: Brandon is an excellent professional, attentive to details, responsible, and punctual. He is a person always willing to learn, transparent, and someone you can consistently rely on within your team.

aaron_garibay.name: Aaron Garibay
aaron_garibay.quote: I highly recommend Brandon to any team that is looking for a highly-skilled, self-taught, and outstanding developer. He is focused on delivering results, and in creating environments where everybody feels free to participate. He shows ownership and a clear understanding of every product that he is involved in. It has been and will be a pleasure to work with him and I am certainly sure he will be an incredibly valuable asset to any team he will incorporate.

joel_campos.name: Joel Campos
joel_campos.quote: We hired Brandon to build a custom admin dashboard for our internal tools. He delivered ahead of schedule, implemented best practices, and the UI/UX was way better than we expected. Highly recommend!

hero.name: Brandon Argel
hero.purpose: I firmly believe in the power of software to create a real, positive impact on people's lives. My purpose is to build digital tools and experiences where empathy, accessibility, and inclusive design allow anyone to benefit from technology.
hero.bio_secondary: I'm a passionate full stack developer dedicated to crafting high-performance web applications, scalable backend architectures, and exceptional user experiences. With over 6 years in the tech industry, I collaborate with clients and teams worldwide to build secure, type-safe systems and robust backend solutions that scale.
